verdict.rationale: Sentry's docs include a 'Fingerprint Rules' page under data-management/event-grouping, which points to an event-grouping system that users can customize with fingerprint rules. The evidence is only a page title and URL path, though, so the automatic stack-trace deduplication is implied rather than described. Missing for 10: any description of how default stack-trace grouping collapses duplicate events into issues, details of the fingerprint-rule syntax or other override mechanisms (merging or splitting issues), and independent or hands-on corroboration that grouping and customization work well.
